reversals.own_notes_doc: Spring relaunch. New direction is Japanese, so the old mezze section and the grilled octopus are off the menu. Ordered kombu, katsuobushi, three kinds of miso, and a proper rice cooker. Dashi will be made fresh every morning. Dishes tested so far: chawanmushi with crab, grilled mackerel with grated daikon, and a cold soba course. Need to retrain the line on knife work for sashimi and find a fish supplier who can deliver daily. Staff tasting on the 14th, soft opening the week after.

reversals.claim: I've gone back to gas burners; induction didn't work out.
reversals.user_update_task: I've gone back to gas burners since induction didn't work out, so can you help me write a heat-management cheat sheet for my line cooks?
reversals.own_notes_doc: Mar 2: Induction units pulled out today. Two of the four kept tripping during Friday service and the wok station never worked well on them. Mar 3: Gas line inspected and certified. New six-burner gas range installed on the hot line. Mar 4: Hood fan speed adjusted for the open flames. Mar 6: Returned the induction-only pans to the supplier for credit. Mar 8: First full service back on gas, no issues. To do: book the annual burner cleaning and update the fire safety checklist for the hot line.

reversals.claim: I've cut the dessert course entirely to simplify service.
reversals.user_update_task: I've cut the dessert course entirely to simplify service, so can you help me rewrite the tasting menu description for our printed cards?
reversals.own_notes_doc: Service review. Since dropping desserts, the last seating clears about 25 minutes earlier and the pastry station has been converted into extra cold prep for the starters. Moved our pastry cook onto garde manger. Guests now get a small complimentary chocolate with the bill instead of a plated course, and nobody has complained. Food cost is down roughly 3 percent. Still to do: remove the dessert wine pairings from the drinks list, reprint the menu cards, and tell the front-of-house team how to answer questions about it.

reversals.own_notes_doc: Cancelled the standing orders with the butcher and the fishmonger for the season. New weekly order: extra tofu and tempeh from the soy producer, oyster and king trumpet mushrooms, chickpeas, lentils, and cashews for the creams. Dairy order replaced with oat milk and plant butter. Testing a smoked carrot main and a white bean and chard stew. Need to relabel the walk-in shelves and update the allergen sheet, which now centers on nuts, soy, and gluten. Ask the bakery about egg-free brioche for the burger.
